{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_patients}')

duplicates_info = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f'Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {len(duplicates_info)}')
print(f'Unique patient_ids: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
